description: Writes original X and LinkedIn posts from the user's own best posts and real numbers, not generic hooks. Builds a per-user pattern library (what wins in their niche plus their own canon), then writes every post finished from the facts in hand (at most one fact flagged to verify), scores it privately against a calibrated rubric, checks it for the tells that make posts sound written by AI, and runs quote-post, reply and weekly modes. When the user sells a service, adds a launch arc, a low-friction offer and a daily engagement-to-DM routine tied to the goal. Use for writing original social posts; to repurpose existing long-form content use /content-atomizer.
